rejected.title: Young people's health
card: Young Australians' health is shaped by many things at once. Common issues include mental health, sexual health, road safety, sleep, social media use and substance use.
Mental health covers how a person thinks, feels and copes. Sleep matters because teenagers often need more than they get, and tiredness can affect mood, learning and safety.
Road safety, sexual health and substance use involve choices and risks. Social media can help young people stay connected, but it can also affect sleep, mood and how they feel about themselves.
Where a young person lives also shapes their health. Those in remote areas may live far from doctors and counsellors, so it can be harder for them to get help.
rejected.remember: Young people's health is shaped by many issues at once, and by where they live.

a.q: Which statement best explains why young people in remote towns can have different health outcomes from those in cities?
opts: They may live far from doctors and counsellors
They are less likely to have any mental health needs
They do not use social media or get tired
They are all more likely to take risks on roads
a.why: Distance can make it harder to reach services, so getting help may take longer. The card does not say remote young people have fewer mental health needs, and it does not say they all behave the same way.
a.clue: Think about how far a person must travel to get help.

b.q: Jaylen, 16, often scrolls on his phone until 1 am and then feels tired and low at school. Which pair of health issues is most directly linked in his case?
opts: Social media use and sleep, which affects his mood
Road safety and sexual health, which affect his sleep
Substance use and where he lives, which affect his phone
Mental health and road safety, which affect his school
b.why: Late-night phone use cuts into sleep, and tiredness can affect mood and learning. The other pairs may be health issues for young people, but nothing in Jaylen's case links them.
b.clue: Look at what he does at 1 am and how he feels the next day.

a.q: Which issue is most likely to be linked to a teenager feeling low at school after many late nights online?
opts: Sleep loss from late-night social media use
Road safety rules in the teenager's town
Sexual health services near the school
Distance to the nearest hospital
a.why: The card says late-night phone use can cut into sleep, and tiredness can affect mood and learning. Distance to services can matter for getting help, but it does not explain why the late nights are affecting mood.
a.clue: Think about what late nights online take away.

b.q: Tane, 15, lives on a remote property and feels anxious. The nearest counsellor is a three-hour drive away. What does this case best show?
opts: Where he lives can make help harder to reach
Anxiety is caused by living on a remote property
Remote young people have no mental health needs
Distance affects road safety but not mental health
b.why: The card says remote areas can be far from doctors and counsellors, so help can be harder to reach. It does not say that living remotely causes anxiety, so that option is wrong even though it sounds close.
b.clue: Focus on the three-hour drive, not on the cause of the anxiety.

a.best: Sleep loss from late-night social media use

b.best: Where he lives can make help harder to reach

a.q: Kai, 16, scrolls social media until 2 am most nights. He feels flat and finds it hard to focus in class. Which link best explains this?
opts: Too little rest leaves him tired, affecting mood and focus
Living far from a doctor leaves him tired and flat in class
Road safety worries leave him tired and unable to focus
Sexual health worries leave him tired and unable to focus
a.why: Staying up until 2 am cuts into sleep, and the card says tiredness can affect mood and learning. Distance from a doctor can make help harder to reach, but nothing in the case links it to how he feels in class.
a.clue: Use only what the case tells you about his nights.

b.q: Tane, 15, lives on a remote property and feels anxious. The nearest counsellor is a three-hour drive away. What does this case best show?
opts: Distance can make support harder for him to reach
Social media can make his anxiety harder to manage
Poor sleep can make his anxiety harder to manage
Substance use can make his anxiety harder to manage
b.why: The case is about a counsellor three hours away, and the card says living remotely can make help harder to reach. Social media, sleep and substance use can all affect mood, but the case gives no detail about any of them.
b.clue: Look at the one detail the case gives about getting help.
